summary: Iteration 21 full-stack verification. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering the NEW done-gate (assignee verdict required per slug, no longer comment-gated), the publish-gate (open comments block publish), and bulk delegate (unknown from_email -> reassigned:0, from==to -> 400, empty email -> 400, real reassign sets assignee_email/delegated_from/status). Frontend: admin entry flow, legacy /admin/docs removal, owner Review Console role UI + hierarchical scope list + cascade/indeterminate selection, bulk-delegate panel, preview-as-reviewer toggle, and done-gate error toast all verified working. Dataset restored: 109 in_review + 12 draft docs, 0 published, 18 assignments all on vishal.k@emergent.sh with delegated_from=None, 0 verdicts, 0 comments.

issues: In reviewer preview the assignment list still shows ALL assignments (vishal.k's 18) and the 'Delegate my reviews' panel lists vishal.k@emergent.sh rather than the current user's own queue. Expected for a preview built on owner data (backend list_assignments returns all for owners), but the panel copy 'Delegate my reviews' + another reviewer's email reads inconsistently. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: review_routes.update_assignment done-gate only enforces verdicts when a.slugs is non-empty; an assignment created for a tab/group that flattens to zero slugs can be marked done with no verdict at all (edge case, no such data today).

Verdicts are always written under the authenticated user's email (POST /verdicts), so an Owner cannot record a verdict on behalf of a reviewer - the done-gate is therefore only satisfiable by the assignee themselves. Intentional? Owner cannot force-close a stale assignment without delegating it first.
No DELETE endpoint for review_verdicts; test/stale verdict rows can only be removed directly in Mongo.
